description: Doula services offered under MassHealth insurance.
whatThisIs: As of spring 2024, doula services are offered under MassHealth insurance, subject to MassHealth coverage limitations. Doulas are non-medical staff who provide emotional, informational, and physical support to you and your family based on your unique needs.
relatedLinkExplanation: An ombudsman can help you get more information about MassHealth coverage plans.
application: PT-1 must first be referred by your primary care office.
whoItHelps: Expecting or currently pregnant individuals looking for extra support during pregnancy.
Individuals looking for postpartum support up to 12 months after delivery.
whatToKnow: Doula coverage is subject to MassHealth coverage limitations for MassHealth members while they are pregnant, during delivery, and up to 12 months after the pregnancy ends.
Doulas can specialize in pregnancy, birth, postpartum support, abortion, and pregnancy/infant loss.
name: MassHealth Doula Services Program
